name: The Cursed Canvas
source:
When you receive a letter from your dear friend Alexandra, you are drawn to her eerie cottage that she has recently inherited. As you venture further into the mystery, you discover a  key to the unsettling occurrences happening around you. 

Will you and Alexandra manage to confront the darkness, or will the darkness lurking within the cottage consume you both? 

The fate of your journey lies in your hands.

[From [url=https://neurodev.itch.io/the-cursed-canvas]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
收到摯友亞歷山德拉的信後，你來到她最近繼承的詭異小屋。隨著你深入謎團，一條能夠解釋周遭怪事的關鍵線索逐漸浮現。

你與亞歷山德拉能否共同直面黑暗，還是會雙雙被潛伏在小屋中的黑暗吞噬？

這趟旅程的命運，掌握在你手中。

[摘自[url=https://neurodev.itch.io/the-cursed-canvas]itch.io[/url]]
